data.gender_notes: Killy is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'killeos', meaning 'strong warrior'. In Christian tradition, Killy represents courage, loyalty, and faith. The name Killy carries the meaning “Strong warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Killy usually hope their child will grow to embody strong warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Killy total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
